links.comparator_used: AI model point predictions without conformal prediction
links.outcome: Error rate of predictions (internal validation, 90% confidence level)
links.effect: 10.5% errors (n=438/4187) with conformal prediction vs 34.6% errors (n=1449) for the AI model without conformal prediction; 1229 (29.4%) predictions flagged for clinician review
links.tradeoff: 29.4% of predictions required clinician review internally; on external validation 38.6% (n=4004) were flagged for review due to interdatabase heterogeneity
links.quote: In contrast, the AI model without conformal prediction made 1449 (34.6%) errors.

design_hint: conformal prediction with clinician review of low-confidence predictions
